Saath hi jaanenge aaj ke sone aur chaandi ke taza bhav kya hai? Isse pehle swagat hai doston, aap sabhi ka ek baar phir se aapke bharosemand YouTube channel Gold Update India ki is nayi video mein. Aaj ki is video mein jaanenge aaj ke 18 carat, 22 carat aur 24 carat sone ke taza bhav kya hai aur aaj ke chaandi ke taza bhav kya hai aur aaj ek tola sone ka taza bhav kya hai? Jisse aapko rozana sone aur chaandi se judi sahi jankari sahi samay par mil sake. To ab jaan lete hain doston, Bharatiya sarafa bazaar ke anusar aaj ke chaandi ke taza bhav kya hai? Aaj chaandi 1 gram ka bhav hai ₹235. 8 gram chaandi ka bhav hai ₹180. 10 gram chaandi ka bhav hai ₹2350, 100 gram chaandi ka bhav hai ₹23,500 aur kilogram chaandi ka bhav hai ₹235,000. Aaj bazaar khulte hi chaandi ki keemat mein ₹1000 per kilogram ki girawat dekhne ko mili hai. Lagataar America se aa rahe bade data ke karan sone aur chaandi ki keemat mein utaar-chadhaav dekhne ko mil raha hai aur antarrashtriya market mein chaandi $3 prati shat ki badi girawat ke saath $64 prati shat ke kareeb kaarobaar kar rahi hai. Agar aap bhi sone aur chaandi ke gehne banwane ki soch rahe hain to is report ko dhyan se suniyega jisse aapko pata lage ki aane wale dinon mein sone chaandi ki keemat mein tezi aayegi ya mandi? 2FexCeZJMPw.text: [Music] Sone aur chaandi ke gehne banwane walon ke liye aa gayi badi khabar saste daamon mein sona chaandi kharidne ka aakhri mauka. Namaskar doston, jaan lete hain aaj ke chaandi aur sone ke taza bhaav kya hai? Isse pehle swagat hai aap sabhi ka ek baar phir se aapke bharosemand YouTube channel Gold Update India ki is nayi video mein. Aaj ki is video mein jaan lete hain aaj ke 18 carat, 22 carat aur 24 carat sone ke taza bhaav kya hai aur aaj ke chaandi ke taza bhaav kya hai aur aaj ek tola sone ka taza bhaav kya hai aur saath hi jaanenge aane wale dinon mein sona chaandi sasta hoga ya mehnga saari baatein aapko batayenge doston bilkul vistaar se. Isse pehle aap is video ko ek pyara sa like aur aapke bharosemand YouTube channel Gold Update India ko subscribe karna na bhoolen jisse aapko rozana sone aur chaandi se judi sahi jaankari sahi samay par mil sake. Aise mein ab jaan lete hain doston Bharatiya sarafa bazaar ke anusar aaj ke chaandi ke taza bhaav kya hai. Isse pehle doston aap apne shahar ka naam comment box mein avashya likhen jisse humein pata lage ki hamari video kahaan-kahaan dekhi ja rahi hai. Aaj chaandi 1 gram ka bhaav hai ₹244. 8 gram chaandi ka bhaav hai ₹1952. 10 gram chaandi ka bhaav hai ₹2440, 100 gram chaandi ka bhaav hai ₹24,400 aur kilogram chaandi ka bhaav hai ₹2,44,000. Aaj bazaar khulte hi chaandi ki keemat mein ₹4000 prati kilogram ki badi tezi dekhne ko mili hai aur is hafte chaandi ki keemat ₹7000 prati kilogram se zyada mehngi ho chuki hai aur antarrashtriya market mein chaandi ki keemat $68 prati ounce ke upar chali gayi hai. Aise mein ab jaanenge varishth vishleshak ke anusar aane wale dinon mein sona chaandi sasta hoga ya mehnga. Agar aap bhi sone aur chaandi ke gehne banwane ki soch rahe hain to is report ko dhyan se suniyega jisse aapko pata lage ki aane wale dinon mein sone chaandi ki keemat mein tezi aa sakti hai ya mandi. Namaskar doston, bada sawaal hai aane wale dinon mein sona aur chaandi saste honge ya mehange? Taza aakdon ka seedha jawab hai. Agle 7 se 15 dinon mein tez utaar-chadhaav reh sakta hai. Lekin badi aur lagataar girawat ki sambhavna filhaal kam hai. Sone mein seemit tezi reh sakti hai. Jabki chaandi mein tezi ke saath achanak girawat ka khatra zyada hai. Sabse pehle yeh samajhna zaroori hai ki sona aur chaandi keval maang aur supply se mehange ya saste nahi hote. Dollar, byaaj dar, bond yield, rupaya, kaccha tel, duniya mein tanaav aur bade niveshkon ki kharid bhi inke bhaav badalti hai. Filhaal inmein se kuch sanket tezi ki taraf hain aur kuch girawat ki taraf. Isi kheench-taan ke kaaran bazaar ek disha mein chalne ke bajay baar-baar upar aur neeche ho sakta hai. Bhaav upar kyon ja sakte hain? Pehla kaaran pashchim Asia ka tanaav hai. Isse kacche tel mein tez uchhal aaya hai. Jab yudh, mehngai ya share bazaar mein dar badhta hai, tab niveshak surakshit maane jaane wale sone ki ore jaate hain. Isse sone ko sahara milta hai aur chaandi bhi saath badh sakti hai. Dusra kaaran kamzor rupaya hai. Rupaya dollar ke muqable dabav mein bana hua hai. Bharat sona aur chaandi badi matra mein aayat karta hai. Isliye dollar mehnga hone par videshi bhaav sthir rahe tab bhi Bharat mein keemat badh sakti hai. Videsh mein thodi girawat aaye tab bhi Bharatiya kharidar ko utni rahat milna zaroori nahi hai. Teesra kaaran majboot nivesh maang hai. World Gold Council

Aaj 22 carat sone ki keematon mein ₹1900 prati 10 gram ki badi girawat dekhne ko mili hai. Woh aaj antarrashtriya market mein sone ki keemat $4420 ke kareeb aa chuki hai. Jo ki kal America se aayi data se pehle $4500 ke upar chali gayi thi. Aur vishleshakon ka maana hai ki agli Fed meeting mein yadi byaaj daron mein katauti hoti hai to sone chaandi ki keematon mein badi girawat bhi dekhne ko mil sakti hai. Lekin bhavishya mein yadi dollar mein tezi aati hai to sone aur chaandi ki keematon mein girawat bhi dekhne ko mil sakti hai aur yadi dollar sasta hoga to sone chaandi ki keematon mein tezi ki sambhavna bhi ban sakti hai. Iske saath hi ab jaan lete hain doston aaj ke 24 carat sone ke taza bhav kya chal rahe hain. Usse pehle sabhi graahakon ko hamari salah hai ki jab bhi aap sone chaandi ke gehne banwane ke liye bazaar jaayein to hamesha jaanch parakh kar sona chaandi khariden aur saath hi dhyan rakhen ki aap jo bhi sona kharid rahe hain us par hallmark nishan diya gaya ho aur saath hi sunar se pakka bill avashya lein jisse aapke saath kisi bhi prakaar ki dhokhadadi na ho aur is video mein sone chaandi ke wholesale ke bhav bataye gaye hain. Isliye sone chaandi ke bhav par aapko 3% GST aur making charge alag se dena hoga. Aaj 24 carat sone ke hisaab se 1 gram sone ka bhav ₹15,300 hai. 8 gram sone ka bhav ₹1,22,400 hai. 10 gram sone ka bhav ₹1,53,000 hai aur 100 gram sone ka bhav ₹15,300 hai.
